about: Generated by scripts/generate_language_policy.py from js/locales; do not edit. The display-language rule of the server (Helpers/LanguageTags.cs) and the client (js/enhanced/translations.js, which carries a generated copy): trim the 'space' characters; a 'reserved' word (any case) is no tag; else the 'tag' expression with each variant once, in canonical case (language lower, Script title, REGION upper, variants lower). A tag is accepted when it or its language is a 'shipped' bundle (any case); anything else is Auto.
